title: Schooling and no music in school
summary: He attended Catholic and private schools, which had no music; he organized the Young Tuxedo band after the Depression.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: By the way, about your schooling, how did you get your schooling? Did you go to a Catholic school or a private school? I went to Magdine 24th, private school. I went to 7 school. Did you go to the Catholic schools at all? I went to Catholic school. I called him Cameroon and called his son John LeVoy.

Did they have any music in school? They didn't have any music in school. You had to pick it up on your own. I just wanted to check on that one point. Let's see, we've gotten into brass band. We've gotten you out to organizing your own young tuxedo. You've had that ever since you organized it. Was that before the depression? That you organized the young tuxedo? Young tuxedo? Yeah. After the depression. It was after the depression. You were playing in the WPA band at the time?
